citations.claim: body outside wall just before violation

counterfactual.change: Reduced initial speed from 37 to 10 m/s, keeping all other parameters identical; substeps now sufficient to handle collision correctly.

explanation: High-speed collision with wall causes tunneling/penetration. At step 3 body is 0.29 outside wall approaching at vx=-37 m/s; next step dt=0.02 with 26 substeps should prevent tunneling but instead body ends 0.35 deep inside wall, with vx flipped sign incorrectly and y slightly changed, indicating substep collision detection failed to prevent penetration and incorrectly resolved velocity.
vision_note: The red ball approaches the grey wall from the right and is just outside it in step 3. In step 4 it is visibly embedded overlapping the right edge of the wall instead of rebounding cleanly.
